parakeet: For millennia, rulers have weaponized distraction and ignorance to secure obedience. Roman emperors fed the masses bread and circuses. Modern media barons sell a 24-7 spectacle. Antonio Gramsci named this cultural hegemony, the subtle control of ideas until they feel like common sense. Across religion, nationalism, consumerism, and self-help dogma, there's an economy of psychic surplus value. Your attention, compliance, even your aspirations get harvested to reinforce hierarchies. Clergy traffic in moral authority. Politicians in loyalty, corporations and desire, gurus in emotional labor. It's Marxist surplus value repurposed. The commodity isn't just labor, but your very beliefs.
